scope: One-thread warm native Rust runtime providers; CPU build is one observation, query times median of five; checksum-sink enumeration, no GPU construction or full output materialization; 50% hits, variable two-to-six payload occurrences/key. Hashbrown is a group-rank directory over pre-existing payload/offset arrays; its build excludes grouping, so build times are not normalized across providers.
processing: Sorted mode charges in-place sort separately; buffer copy excluded; provider_probe32 uses each provider actual IndexRead::probe implementation, not a promise of batching for every provider; segmented32 only for Copy exact-size range cursors
